notes.title: LYNE v1.5.0 - Tenth anniversary update
notes.content:
[h2]What's new ~[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] ːlynehaltː Added full controller support.
[*] ːlyneknotː Greatly increased the variety of levels created in the daily mode.
[*]  ːlyneleapː Levels now rotate to match screen aspect ratio.
[*] ːlynevisionː Redesigned menus.
[*] ːlyneglowː Compatibility improvements and small fixes.
[/list][/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5752777/99a311b0017fb0a4eafb382a51a10273a8e973b0.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5752777/99a311b0017fb0a4eafb382a51a10273a8e973b0.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Controller Support[/h3]
The controller support I’ve added works a lot better than I expected and I’m very happy with it. Something that might feel awkward is the D-Pad is only enabled for UI navigation and is disabled during puzzle gameplay, the reason for this is the game requires diagonal movement and I didn’t want to confuse new players by having both D-Pad and Stick input enabled at the same time.
Most standard controllers should work automatically, let me know what you think or if you run into any issues.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5752777/5c3ed6c33b98d4cd3b9e3efa083d6920baa33f06.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5752777/5c3ed6c33b98d4cd3b9e3efa083d6920baa33f06.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Updated daily mode[/h3]
I did a huge overhaul of the daily levels and increased the variety of puzzles generated by almost 4x.
You will now encounter difficult level sets with fewer overall puzzles, and there are special sets that only appear on weekends.
I have decided to reduce the amount of puzzles per day, but the increase in variety I think is worth it. Feel free to change your computer date to try out different days. Let me know what you think.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5752777/146956b88322922d3c748cb640c348c49a90357c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5752777/146956b88322922d3c748cb640c348c49a90357c.gif[/img][/url]

This will almost certainly be the last update for LYNE. I’m very happy with it and I’m looking forward to finally getting onto finishing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/289980/Split_Signal/]Split Signal[/url].

Thanks so much for playing.
- Tom

notes.title: LYNE Version 1.4.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I've updated LYNE to version 1.4.5 ːlyneleapː.

This mainly is a big maintenance and platform compatibility update.

- Unity engine updated to Unity 2019.4.
- You can now resize the game window to whatever shape you want!
- Resolution and fullscreen options in game.
- You can now disable the scrolling animations.
- New exit button in the main menu to close the game.

Unity has removed the config dialogue window in this version, I've added the ability to resize the window and better fullscreen support. If there were any features that you are missing due to this change please let me know.

The option to disable the scrolling animation is mainly for accessibility for anyone experiencing motion sickness but it also allows you to play the game much faster.

- Tom

notes.title: LYNE version 1.2.0 - Cloud Saves
notes.content:
Hello friends,

It's been a very long time but I had some spare to update LYNE.

v1.2.0
- Unity version update
- Save system converted to using a file
- Lots of small fixes
- Cloud support on Steam

The save file is in the folder 'saves' in the steam installation folder for LYNE and will sync automatically to Steam.

If you had old save data it will be converted to the new save system on first launch.


UPDATE
I added a way to sync your save with the steam achievements you have, details here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/266010/discussions/0/2592234299552594972/
